description: This file contains PHP unit tests for the AttendanceConfigurationAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup, data provisioning, and test methods for API actions like 'getOne' and 'update', as well as tests verifying the handling of unimplemented methods like 'delete'.

classes.name: AttendanceConfigurationAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for the AttendanceConfigurationAPI, providing tests for retrieving, updating, and handling unimplemented delete functionality of attendance configuration via API.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' method of the API to ensure it retrieves attendance configuration properly.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the 'update' method of the API to verify updating attendance configuration works correctly.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that calling 'delete' throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that validation rules for 'delete' are properly handled, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test data for the 'getOne' API test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test data for the 'update' API test cases.
